input.free_text_description: This system is a authentication platform that serves User, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including user, role. The platform provides capabilities for user details, user details. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include content management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage role records, so that I can track and organize role data effectively.
As a User, I want to interact with test functionality, so that I can accomplish my test-related tasks.
As a User, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
